tagCollision.detail: Angular component selector 'smilodon-select' collides with core NativeSelectElement defined as 'smilodon-select' (native-select.ts:562-563). When the deferred import('@smilodon/core') runs, the Angular host is upgraded (attachShadow) by NativeSelectElement; a foreign shadow root attaches to the host. The real combobox remains inside the <enhanced-select> shadow root. No hydration mismatch and no visible artifact observed.
tagCollision.note: Per directive: preserve minimal reproduction; do NOT change selectors or suppress core registration.
